name: smithers
description: A personal email and calendar desk: your inbox split into what needs a reply, a 7-day calendar with multi-select delete, tasks, a Compose tab, and a Chat tab for talking to Claude Code from inside the app. An optional script keeps two Google calendars in sync. Claude Code reads your Gmail and Calendar through a local connector, writes a fresh overview of what’s ahead for the next seven days every time the app is opened, and parks drafted replies in Compose — you review and press Send. Sending mail and editing, deleting, or applying calendar changes are your clicks in the app; a hook and a per-launch page token keep Claude off those routes.
